name: HC10f: CRAG Positive treated with fluconazole
description: Number of CRAG positive clients treated with pre-emptive fluconazole - PLACEHOLDER: Requires ETL enhancement for fluconazole tracking
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
configJson:
{
  "version": 1,
  "patientIdColumn": "patient_id",

    "extractFrom": "sqlTemplate"

  "redisaggregationStrategy": "population-extraction",
  "themeIndependent": true,
  "dataSources": [
    "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary",

  "sqlTemplate": "SELECT DISTINCT s.client_id AS patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
WHERE s.client_id IS NOT NULL
  AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date >= :startDate
  AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  AND s.hiv_enrollment_date IS NOT NULL
  AND DATEDIFF(
      s.baseline_regimen_start_date,
      s.hiv_enrollment_date
  ) <= 7

  AND s.baseline_cd4 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.baseline_cd4) REGEXP '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'

            AND r.encounter_datetime >= :startDate
            AND r.encounter_datetime < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            AND r.test_concept_id IN (
                164986,
                165290,
                199990
            )
            AND UPPER(TRIM(r.test_value)) IN (
                'POSITIVE',
                'POS',
                '+',
                '(+)'
            )
      )
      OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
          WHERE a.client_id = s.client_id
            AND a.encounter_date >= :startDate
            AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            AND UPPER(TRIM(a.crag_test_results)) LIKE '%POSITIVE%'
      )
  )
  AND EXISTS (

        AND o.value_coded = 1065
        AND o.voided = 0
        AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate
        AND o.obs_datetime < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
